newsitem.title: USA: America First PREP sells Tulsa property.
newsitem.headline: America First PREP sells Tulsa property.

text.p: America First PREP Fund 2 LP said Thursday it sold its limited partnership interest in Ashwood Apartments in Tulsa, Okla.
PREP 2 and a related company, America First PREP Fund 2 Pension Series LP, realized a gain of about $825,000 from the sale of their interests. A total of $599,000 of the gain was earned by PREP 2 LP.

PREP 2 held a mortgage on the property, which was paid in full on January 15, 1997. PREP 2 said it realized an internal rate of return on its total investment in this property of more than 11 percent.
